name: sn58-validator-dashboard
description: Local SN58-inspired validator dashboard (MERN technical assessment starter)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sn58/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sn58/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
